description: The isOvenReady method checks whether an oven is ready for baking. An oven is considered ready when its temperature is between 150°C and 250°C (inclusive).

The calculateBusTicketPrice method calculates the bus ticket price for a single trip. Children under 12 and seniors over 65 pay €3.00. All other passengers pay an additional €2.00 on top of the standard ticket price.

The calculateProductDiscount method calculates the discount for a retail store. The online store offers a €5.00 discount for orders above €100. The physical store offers a €5.00 discount for all orders.

The calculateChargingTimeMinutes method calculates how many minutes it takes to fully charge (100%) a smartphone. Starting from an initial battery level, the smartphone charges at 2% per minute if the battery level is 80% or below, and 1% per minute if above 80%.
The largestNumber method returns the largest number from a non-empty array. The search stops if a negative number is encountered. The array is guaranteed to be non-empty.

The isEligibleForBonus method determines whether a student receives a bonus for their final course grade. A student is eligible if they accumulate at least 5 homework points. If the student has an exemption, they earn 1 point per submitted homework. Otherwise, they earn 1 point per homework with a grade of 80 or higher.

The calculateDailySalary method calculates the daily salary of an employee. The base hourly salary is €15.00. Employees working on weekdays and day shifts receive the standard rate. Otherwise, the hourly rate is increased by 50%.
